name: sky130-pll
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:base: npm run lint && npm run test && ./.loom/scripts/check-xschem-embedded-quotes.sh && python3 signoff/readme-manifest-consistency.py && python3 signoff/design-snapshot-consistency.py && python3 scripts/check_artifact_manifests.py --tree HEAD
scripts.test: npm run test:compile && npm run test:unit && npm run test:shell
scripts.test:unit: python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory sim/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory layout/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory measurements/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory signoff/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory design/lock-detector/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory sim/phase-quadrature-model --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory scripts/tests --pattern 'test_*.py'
scripts.lint: find sim layout measurements signoff -name '*.json' -not -path 'layout/.venv/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n1 python3 -m json.tool > /dev/null && bash scripts/lint-shell-syntax.sh
